excerpt: On January 8 at 04:24 UTC the maintainer of colors.js published 1.4.44-liberty-2. At 19:22 he published 1.4.1. On January 9, 1.4.2. The first one got the coverage. The last two burned the ecosystem. The story everyone told was 1.4.44-liberty-2. It shipped as a prerelease, and prereleases never match caret ranges, so it only hit people installing latest. The ecosystem-wide burn came from 1.4.1 and 1.4.2, legitimate-looking patches inside ^1.4.0, the range half the registry declares.
title: colors.js and the trust budget
